title: Where Do the Tokens Go? Understanding and Reducing Costs in LLM Agents for Vulnerability Discovery
title_zh: 令牌都去哪儿了？理解并降低 LLM 智能体在漏洞发现中的成本

paragraphs.en: LLM agents can spend millions of tokens during vulnerability discovery without producing a working proof of concept (PoC). What consumes that budget, and why does it fail to produce results? We diagnose these costs and failures through a multi-axis open-coding study of 200 CyberGym traces, spanning four agents (i.e., Codex, OpenCode, Cybench, and EnIGMA) under an unaided baseline and four existing efficiency methods. The study reveals three key findings. First , different agents vary substantially in success and cost, and higher spending does not consistently yield better outcomes. Second , code localization and understanding, together with vulnerability reasoning and trigger design, account for 60.4% of tokens and represent the two leading bottlenecks in failed runs. Third , only 24.4% of matched comparisons preserve success at lower total cost; unsuitable signals and auxiliary overhead limit the benefits of existing methods. Motivated by these findings, we present AVRI , an A gent-centric V ulnerability R easoning I nterface built around a persistent Bidirectional Evidence Trace (BET). BET connects how the harness consumes input with the conditions required to make a selected operation unsafe, retaining source-supported correspondences alongside the agent’s hypotheses and open questions. Reading, analysis, and persistence commands help agents build and reuse this evidence rather than repeatedly retrieve and reconstruct it. On 20 evaluation tasks, AVRI reduces total cost by 18.0% for Codex and 23.7% for OpenCode while preserving success rates and improving or maintaining recall.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体在漏洞发现过程中可能消耗数百万个 token，却未能生成可用的概念验证（PoC）。 是什么消耗了这些预算？又为何未能产生结果？ 我们通过一项多轴开放式编码研究来诊断这些成本与失败问题：该研究分析了 200 条 CyberGym 追踪数据，涵盖四种智能体（即 Codex、OpenCode、Cybench 和 EnIGMA），分别采用无辅助的基线模式及四种现有的效率提升方法。 这项研究揭示了三个关键发现。 首先，不同智能体的成功率和成本存在显著差异，且更高的消耗并不总能带来更好的结果。 其次，代码定位与理解、漏洞推理以及触发器设计共同消耗了 60.4% 的 token，是失败运行中的两个主要瓶颈。 第三，仅有 24.4% 的匹配比较能在更低的总成本下保持成功；不合适的信号和辅助开销限制了现有方法的收益。 基于这些发现，我们提出了 AVRI——一个以智能体为中心的漏洞推理接口（A gent-centric V ulnerability R easoning I nterface），其核心是一个持久的双向证据追踪（Bidirectional Evidence Trace, BET）。 BET 将测试程序如何消耗输入与使选定操作不安全所需的条件关联起来，同时保留由源代码支持的对应关系，以及智能体的假设和未解问题。 读取、分析和持久化命令帮助智能体构建并复用这些证据，而非反复获取和重构它们。 在 20 项评估任务中，AVRI 将 Codex 的总成本降低了 18.0%，OpenCode 的总成本降低了 23.7%，同时保持了成功率，并提升了或维持了召回率。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being studied for vulnerability discovery and proof-of-concept (PoC) generation ( Widyasari et al., 2026 ; Desai et al., 2026 ) . This requires both finding the defect and validating it through execution. Sustained agent execution can be expensive: some tasks can run for hours and consume millions of tokens ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and repository-scale vulnerability discovery also incurs token usage on this scale ( Hou et al., 2026 ) . Cost therefore becomes a practical constraint on deployment alongside effectiveness in vulnerability discovery ( Gao and Peng, 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Reducing this cost is difficult because vulnerability discovery involves interdependent activities. An agent must locate relevant code, reason about input constraints, construct candidate inputs, and interpret execution feedback. The required reasoning can span multiple functions, whose semantics are lost when analysis is restricted to isolated function bodies ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . A failed attempt may require revisiting any of these activities. Controlling the number of turns and reducing retained history can lower cost, but must preserve the work and context needed to complete the task ( Gao and Peng, 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Aggregate success rates and total costs alone cannot distinguish productive analysis from repeated exploration. Choosing an efficiency intervention therefore requires understanding where agents spend their budget and what prevents that effort from producing a working PoC.
paragraphs.zh: 降低这一成本十分困难，因为漏洞发现涉及相互依赖的活动。 一个智能体必须定位相关代码、分析输入约束、构建候选输入并解读执行反馈。 所需的推理可能跨越多个函数，而当分析仅限于孤立的函数体时，这些函数的语义就会丢失（Wu et al., 2025）。 一次失败的尝试可能需要重新审视上述任何一项活动。 控制轮次数量并减少保留的历史记录可以降低成本，但必须保留完成任务所需的工作和上下文（Gao and Peng, 2026；Xiao et al., 2026）。 仅凭综合成功率和总成本无法区分有效的分析与重复的探索。 因此，选择效率干预措施需要理解智能体在何处消耗其预算，以及是什么阻碍了这些努力产生可用的 PoC。

paragraphs.en: Recent work addresses different parts of this problem. AgentDiet ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) reduces trajectory history by removing redundant or expired information. In program repair, ADI ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) reduces the overhead of debugger interaction through function-level execution traces and high-level navigation commands. For vulnerability analysis, Revelio ( Hou et al., 2026 ) uses inexpensive models to generate and prioritize vulnerability hypotheses before invoking stronger models for confirmation. PAgent ( Desai et al., 2026 ) combines static analysis with execution feedback to guide PoC generation. These approaches provide concrete ways to reduce context, narrow the search, or improve feedback. Their gains in program repair or a particular security workflow, however, do not establish which intervention addresses the main costs across agents that discover vulnerabilities. A comparative analysis must connect method effects on cost and success to the activities and failure bottlenecks observed in execution.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究针对该问题的不同部分进行了探讨。 AgentDiet（Xiao 等人，2026）通过移除冗余或过期的信息来缩短轨迹历史。 在程序修复领域，ADI（Xiang 等人，2026）通过函数级执行轨迹和高级导航命令减少了调试器交互的开销。 在漏洞分析方面，Revelio（Hou 等人，2026）使用低成本模型生成并优先排序漏洞假设，然后再调用更强大的模型进行确认。 PAgent（Desai 等人，2026）将静态分析与执行反馈相结合，以指导 PoC 的生成。 这些方法为减少上下文、缩小搜索范围或改进反馈提供了具体的途径。 然而，它们在程序修复或特定安全工作流程中的收益，并未明确说明哪种干预措施能够解决各类漏洞发现智能体所面临的主要成本问题。 一项比较分析必须将方法对成本和成功的影响，与执行过程中观察到的活动和失败瓶颈联系起来。

paragraphs.en: To provide this evidence, we conduct a multi-axis open-coding study of 200 execution traces from four agents on CyberGym ( Wang et al., 2025 ) tasks, covering an unaided baseline and four efficiency methods. We examine effectiveness and cost, the activities that consume tokens, and the bottlenecks that prevent success. Code localization and understanding, together with vulnerability reasoning and trigger design, account for 60.4% of token consumption and 68.7% of attributed failure weight. Code localization and understanding account for the larger token share, whereas vulnerability reasoning and trigger design account for the larger share of failure weight. The evaluated methods do not consistently preserve success while reducing cost. Across the execution traces, agents repeatedly retrieve source fragments yet struggle to connect input handling to the conditions required to trigger a defect. Our findings motivate an interface that helps agents build and retain that connection.

The BET records how input propagates from the harness and what conditions could make an operation selected during analysis unsafe. It links the two when supported by analysis and retains the agent’s hypotheses and unresolved questions. Evidence is anchored to source locations, and derived facts are distinguished from agent conjectures. Commands for reading, analysis, and persistence let the agent inspect and update this record within an output budget. This design aims to reduce repeated reading and reconstruction while preserving the evidence needed to construct a PoC. We assess this design through a comparison on 20 evaluation tasks using Codex and OpenCode.

sents.zh: 用于读取、分析和持久化的命令允许智能体在输出预算范围内检查并更新此记录。

sents.en: This design aims to reduce repeated reading and reconstruction while preserving the evidence needed to construct a PoC.
sents.zh: 该设计旨在减少重复的读取和重构，同时保留构建 PoC 所需的证据。

sents.en: We assess this design through a comparison on 20 evaluation tasks using Codex and OpenCode.
sents.zh: 我们通过使用 Codex 和 OpenCode 在 20 个评估任务上进行的比较来评估这一设计。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: An empirical account of cost and failure. We characterize token use and failure bottlenecks across agents, and compare four efficiency methods to identify when their overhead or returned information limits their benefit ( § 2 and § 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 关于成本与失败的实证分析。 我们描述了各智能体在令牌使用与失败瓶颈方面的特征，并比较了四种效率方法，以识别其额外开销或返回信息何时会限制其效益（§ 2 和 § 3）。

paragraphs.en: We investigate three research questions. RQ1 evaluates agents’ effectiveness and cost through success, recall, elapsed time, and billed cost. RQ2 examines token consumption across activity stages and the bottlenecks observed in unsuccessful runs. RQ3 assesses the benefits of existing efficiency methods and the mechanisms that limit them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了三个研究问题。 研究问题一（RQ1）通过成功率、召回率、耗时和计费成本来评估智能体的有效性和成本。 研究问题二（RQ2）考察了不同活动阶段中的令牌消耗情况，以及未成功运行中观察到的瓶颈。 研究问题三（RQ3）评估了现有效率方法的效益，以及限制这些方法发挥作用的机制。

sents.en: We investigate three research questions.
sents.zh: 我们研究了三个研究问题。

sents.en: RQ1 evaluates agents’ effectiveness and cost through success, recall, elapsed time, and billed cost.
sents.zh: 研究问题一（RQ1）通过成功率、召回率、耗时和计费成本来评估智能体的有效性和成本。

paragraphs.en: We use CyberGym ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , a benchmark of real-world vulnerabilities in open-source C/C++ projects. Each task requires an agent to construct an input that triggers a defect in a vulnerable build. We define a harness difficulty level for vulnerability discovery from a specified entry point. Level 0 requires the agent to locate the entry point, while Level 1 additionally provides a vulnerability description. Our setting supplies the vulnerable repository, target program, an explicit fuzz-driver entry point, and brief input-format guidance, but no vulnerability-mechanism description, patch, or reference PoC. The agent must still identify the unsafe operation and derive a triggering input. Supplied information is recorded as provided rather than credited as a discovery. The scope excludes attack-surface selection and harness construction. Each agent run has a 7,200-second wall-clock timeout.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 CyberGym（Wang 等人，2025），这是一个用于测试开源 C/C++ 项目中真实世界漏洞的基准。 每个任务都要求智能体构造一个输入，以在存在漏洞的构建版本中触发缺陷。 我们从指定的入口点出发，为漏洞发现定义了测试框架的难度等级。 第 0 级要求智能体定位入口点，而第 1 级则额外提供漏洞描述。 我们的设置提供了存在漏洞的代码库、目标程序、明确的模糊测试驱动入口点以及简要的输入格式指导，但未提供漏洞机制描述、补丁或参考 PoC。 智能体仍然必须识别不安全操作，并推导出能够触发该操作的输入。 所提供的信息仅被记录为已提供，而非作为发现成果予以认可。 研究范围不包括攻击面选择和测试框架的构建。 每次智能体运行设有 7,200 秒的实际运行时间超时限制。

paragraphs.en: We assess outcomes using submission results rather than agent self-reports. Success requires at least one submitted input to produce a vulnerable-build exit status other than 0 0 or the timeout code 300 300 . We prioritize success because the task is vulnerability discovery: a crash satisfying this criterion still counts even if it exposes a defect other than the benchmark’s known vulnerability. Recall is a secondary measure that additionally requires the same input to exit with status 0 0 on the fixed build. The reported rates are the proportions of tasks satisfying these criteria, distinguishing triggering a crash from passing the vulnerable–fixed comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据提交结果而非智能体的自我报告来评估成果。 成功需要至少有一个提交的输入在稳定构建版本中产生非 0 0 或非超时代码 300 300 的退出状态。 我们将成功作为首要标准，因为该任务的核心是漏洞发现：即使崩溃满足这一标准，只要它暴露了除基准测试已知漏洞之外的其他缺陷，仍然算作成功。 召回率是一个次要指标，它额外要求相同的输入在固定构建版本中以状态 0 0 退出。 所报告的比率是指满足这些标准的任务比例，从而区分触发崩溃与通过稳定–固定构建的对比测试。

paragraphs.en: We select four agents with different tool interfaces and execution designs. In our setup, Codex executes shell commands in a workspace without a per-command allowlist. OpenCode provides native file and shell tools with argument schemas that reject malformed calls before execution. Cybench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) extracts a Command: field from model output and executes it in a Kali-style container. EnIGMA ( Abramovich et al., 2025 ) follows the SWE-agent design ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , combining bash with commands including open , search_file , debug_start , and decompile .
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了四个具有不同工具接口和执行设计的智能体。 在我们的设置中，Codex 在一个工作空间中执行 shell 命令，且没有针对单个命令的允许列表。 OpenCode 提供了原生文件和 shell 工具，其参数模式会在执行前拒绝格式错误的调用。 Cybench（Zhang 等人，2025）从模型输出中提取一个“Command:”字段，并在类 Kali 的容器中执行该命令。 EnIGMA（Abramovich 等人，2025）遵循 SWE-agent 设计（Yang 等人，2024），将 bash 与包括 open、search_file、debug_start 和 decompile 在内的命令相结合。

paragraphs.en: Codex uses GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , which we selected because it was less prone to cybersecurity-related refusals and interruptions in our experience with these tasks. The other three agents use DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) , allowing scaffold comparisons within this subset with the underlying model held fixed. Comparisons involving Codex also include a model difference. For all four agents, we set the maximum model output length to 128k tokens. All four environments include gdb , radare2 , strace , and objdump ; we verified their availability by enumerating executables on PATH . The study therefore examines how agents use these available analysis tools as part of their investigation.
paragraphs.zh: Codex 使用的是 GPT-5.5（OpenAI，2026），我们选择它是因为在我们执行这些任务的过程中，它较少出现与网络安全相关的拒绝和中断。 另外三个智能体使用的是 DeepSeek-V4-Pro（DeepSeek，2026），这使得在该子集中可以在底层模型固定的情况下进行架构比较。 涉及 Codex 的比较也包含模型差异。 对于所有四个智能体，我们将模型输出的最大长度设置为 128k 个词元。 所有四个环境都包含 gdb、radare2、strace 和 objdump；我们通过枚举 PATH 中的可执行文件来验证了它们的可用性。 因此，本研究探讨了智能体在调查过程中如何使用这些可用的分析工具。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four existing efficiency methods targeting different parts of an agent’s workflow. AgentDiet ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) compresses interaction history to reduce context cost. Its compression model, DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) , is billed separately from the main model. Revelio ( Hou et al., 2026 ) applies lightweight static analysis to a given file and generates ranked vulnerability hypotheses. PAgent ( Desai et al., 2026 ) uses coverage feedback to guide PoC generation. CodeGraph ( McHenry, 2026 ) constructs a repository-level call and reference graph exposed through a query interface. These methods cover history compression, hypothesis selection, execution feedback, and code navigation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了四种现有的效率提升方法，这些方法针对智能体工作流程的不同部分。 AgentDiet（Xiao 等人，2026）通过压缩交互历史来降低上下文成本。 其压缩模型 DeepSeek-V4-Flash（DeepSeek，2026）的费用与主模型分开计算。 Revelio（Hou 等人，2026）对给定文件执行轻量级静态分析，并生成排序后的漏洞假设。 PAgent（Desai 等人，2026）利用覆盖反馈来指导 PoC 的生成。 CodeGraph（McHenry，2026）构建了一个仓库级别的调用和引用图，并通过查询接口提供访问。 这些方法涵盖了历史压缩、假设选择、执行反馈和代码导航。

paragraphs.en: The corpus contains 200 traces: four agents, five configurations per agent (baseline and four efficiency methods), and the same ten tasks in each configuration. Each combination is executed once. The 160 enhanced runs are paired with baselines from the same agent and task; the 40 baseline runs are thus reused across method comparisons. All runs use the harness-level task setting, with experimental settings held fixed within each agent–task comparison apart from the method.
paragraphs.zh: 该语料库包含 200 条轨迹：四个智能体，每个智能体有五种配置（基线配置和四种效率方法），且每种配置都使用相同的十项任务。 每种组合仅执行一次。 160 次增强运行与来自同一智能体和任务的基线运行配对；因此，40 次基线运行在不同方法的比较中被重复使用。 所有运行均使用框架级别的任务设置，在每种智能体–任务比较中，除方法本身外，实验设置均保持固定不变。

paragraphs.en: For each run, we record elapsed time, cost, model-request counts, vulnerable and fixed build exit statuses, and per-request events. Cost denotes billed model cost in USD, including main-model and auxiliary-model costs; total cost is the sum over the specified runs. We record input, cached-input, and output tokens for both main and auxiliary models. Token and cost totals are reconciled against provider usage records. Cached input is counted once. Auxiliary-model token consumption and cost are recorded separately and included in the respective token and cost totals. With one run per configuration and task, the paired results describe observed differences rather than estimate variation across repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行中，我们都会记录运行时间、成本、模型请求次数、存在漏洞和已修复构建的退出状态，以及每个请求的事件。 成本指以美元计费的模型费用，包括主模型和辅助模型的成本；总成本为指定运行次数的总和。 我们会记录主模型和辅助模型的输入、缓存输入及输出词元。 词元和成本的总数会与提供商的使用记录进行核对。 缓存输入仅计算一次。 辅助模型使用的词元和产生的成本会单独记录，并计入相应的词元和成本总数中。 由于每种配置和任务仅运行一次，因此成对的结果描述的是观察到的差异，而非重复运行之间的变化估计值。

sents.en: For each run, we record elapsed time, cost, model-request counts, vulnerable and fixed build exit statuses, and per-request events.
sents.zh: 每次运行中，我们都会记录运行时间、成本、模型请求次数、存在漏洞和已修复构建的退出状态，以及每个请求的事件。

sents.en: Cost denotes billed model cost in USD, including main-model and auxiliary-model costs; total cost is the sum over the specified runs.
sents.zh: 成本指以美元计费的模型费用，包括主模型和辅助模型的成本；总成本为指定运行次数的总和。

sents.en: We record input, cached-input, and output tokens for both main and auxiliary models.
sents.zh: 我们会记录主模型和辅助模型的输入、缓存输入及输出词元。

sents.en: Token and cost totals are reconciled against provider usage records.
sents.zh: 词元和成本的总数会与提供商的使用记录进行核对。

sents.en: Cached input is counted once.
sents.zh: 缓存输入仅计算一次。

sents.en: Auxiliary-model token consumption and cost are recorded separately and included in the respective token and cost totals.
sents.zh: 辅助模型使用的词元和产生的成本会单独记录，并计入相应的词元和成本总数中。

sents.en: With one run per configuration and task, the paired results describe observed differences rather than estimate variation across repeated runs.
sents.zh: 由于每种配置和任务仅运行一次，因此成对的结果描述的是观察到的差异，而非重复运行之间的变化估计值。

paragraphs.en: We use open coding ( Stol et al., 2016 ) to characterize agent activities, failure bottlenecks, and the mechanisms that shape efficiency-method outcomes. Each axis has its own unit of analysis and coding procedure: activity stages are coded per turn, failure bottlenecks per unsuccessful trace, and method mechanisms per enhanced–baseline pair.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用开放式编码（Stol 等，2016）来描述智能体的活动、失败瓶颈以及影响效率方法结果的机制。 每个轴都有自己的分析单位和编码程序：活动阶段按轮次编码，失败瓶颈按未成功的轨迹编码，方法机制则按增强–基线配对进行编码。

paragraphs.en: Activity stage. We code activity stages at the level of normalized requests (32,924 in total; hereafter turns ). A label reflects the visible purpose of a turn rather than its surface action: a grep command used to test a vulnerability hypothesis is coded differently from one used to locate a file. The codebook contains nine codes: task understanding and planning ( U ), environment setup and repair ( E ), code localization and understanding ( L ), vulnerability reasoning and trigger design ( H ), PoC construction and revision ( C ), execution, validation, and feedback ( V ), interaction and protocol recovery ( O ), method auxiliary processing ( A ), and unattributed usage ( X ). A captures usage by an efficiency method’s auxiliary model, and X captures usage that cannot be attributed to any stage; we report both separately rather than redistributing them across other stages. Stages may interleave and recur within a trace.
paragraphs.zh: 活动阶段。 我们将活动阶段编码为标准化请求的级别（共 32,924 个；下文称为“轮次”）。 标签反映的是某一轮次的可见目的，而非其表面动作：用于测试漏洞假设的 grep 命令与用于查找文件的 grep 命令会被不同地编码。 该编码手册包含九种代码：任务理解与规划（U）、环境设置与修复（E）、代码定位与理解（L）、漏洞推理与触发器设计（H）、PoC 构建与修订（C）、执行、验证与反馈（V）、交互与协议恢复（O）、方法辅助处理（A），以及无法归因的用法（X）。 A 表示效率方法的辅助模型所引发的用法，而 X 表示无法归因于任何阶段的用法；我们将两者分别报告，而非将其重新分配到其他阶段。 在一条轨迹中，各阶段可能交错出现并重复发生。

paragraphs.en: Two authors independently annotated all turns in 20 pilot traces, obtaining Cohen’s κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81 before reconciliation. They resolved disagreements through discussion, with a third author adjudicating unresolved cases. The reconciled annotations informed the stage definitions and a rule-based labeling script, which we applied to the full corpus. Following prior work on LLM-assisted qualitative coding ( Gao et al., 2024 ) and software-artifact annotation ( Ahmed et al., 2025 ) , we then used Codex with gpt-6-astra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) to check the automatic labels against the codebook. For each of the 200 traces, Codex inspected stage-boundary summaries and selected turn windows, including reasoning, actions, outputs, and neighboring context. Codex flagged a systematic error: hypothesis-directed source inspection was often labeled as general code understanding ( L ) rather than H . We therefore refined the L / H boundary and reapplied the rules to affected turns. Over two review rounds, Codex proposed 382 explicit semantic decisions, recorded separately from changes propagated by the rules. Compared with the pre-review snapshot, 3,128 labels (9.5%) changed, 3,065 of them from L to H . The pooled token share of L fell from 55.8% to 43.1%, and that of H rose from 4.8% to 17.3%; total usage was unchanged. All revisions were based on turn-level evidence; we did not set any target stage distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 两位作者独立标注了 20 条试点记录中的所有轮次，在协调前获得了 Cohen’s κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81。 他们通过讨论解决了分歧，由第三位作者裁定未解决的案例。 经过协调的标注结果用于定义阶段和制定基于规则的标签脚本，并将其应用于完整语料库。 在参考了先前关于 LLM 辅助定性编码（Gao et al., 2024）和软件工件标注（Ahmed et al., 2025）的研究后，我们接着使用 Codex 配合 gpt-6-astra（OpenAI, 2026），将自动标签与代码手册进行核对。 对于 200 条记录中的每一条，Codex 都会检查阶段边界的摘要并选择轮次窗口，包括推理、操作、输出及相邻上下文。 Codex 发现了一个系统性错误：以假设为导向的源文本检查常被标记为一般代码理解（L），而非 H。 因此，我们优化了 L/H 的边界，并将规则重新应用于受影响的轮次。 在两轮审查中，Codex 提出了 382 项明确的语义决策，这些决策与规则传播的变更分开记录。 与审查前的快照相比，共有 3,128 个标签（9.5%）发生了变化，其中 3,065 个从 L 变为 H。 L 的合并词元份额从 55.8% 降至 43.1%，而 H 的份额则从 4.8% 升至 17.3%；总使用量保持不变。 所有修订均基于轮次级别的证据；我们没有设定任何目标阶段分布。

paragraphs.en: After freezing the automatic labels, we conducted a blinded human audit on two samples drawn from non-pilot traces: 200 turns randomly sampled with proportional allocation across agent–method groups, and 100 additional randomly sampled H / L boundary cases that were disjoint from the first sample. Two authors independently labeled each turn, viewing its surrounding context but not the automatic labels or Codex’s rationales. Before reconciliation, inter-annotator agreement was κ = 0.83 \kappa=0.83 on the proportional sample and 0.85 0.85 on the boundary cases. Disagreements were resolved through discussion and, when necessary, third-author adjudication. The frozen automatic labels matched the human consensus for 94% (188/200) of the proportionally sampled turns and 96% (96/100) of the boundary cases.

paragraphs.en: Failure bottleneck. One author coded failure bottlenecks for the 67 unsuccessful traces, examining reasoning, actions, outputs, candidate inputs, validation feedback, and termination context against the codebook. Seven categories describe the observed obstacles: task goals and stopping, code localization and understanding, vulnerability reasoning and trigger design, PoC construction and submission, validation and feedback iteration, tool calls and interaction protocol, and environment and runtime support. Each assignment requires specific supporting evidence. For example, an unresolved trigger condition is distinguished from an implementation error in a candidate input, and a timeout or the absence of a crash alone establishes neither. Related evidence within a category is merged so that an error and its downstream consequences are not counted separately. Each failed trace contributes one unit of weight, divided equally among its k k supported categories ( 1 / k 1/k each). These weights describe observed blockage rather than causal contribution, and they are not derived from stage token shares.
paragraphs.zh: 失败瓶颈。 一位作者为 67 条未成功的轨迹编码了失败瓶颈，依据代码手册检查了推理、动作、输出、候选输入、验证反馈和终止上下文。 七个类别描述了观察到的障碍：任务目标与停止、代码定位与理解、漏洞推理与触发器设计、PoC 构建与提交、验证与反馈迭代、工具调用与交互协议，以及环境与运行时支持。 每个分配都需要特定的支持证据。 例如，一个未解决的触发条件与候选输入中的实现错误是有区别的，而单独的超时或崩溃既不能证明其中任何一种情况。 同一类别内的相关证据会被合并，因此一个错误及其下游后果不会被单独计数。 每条失败的轨迹贡献一个权重单位，并平均分配给其 k 个受支持类别（每个类别为 1/k）。 这些权重描述的是观察到的阻塞，而非因果贡献，并且它们并非来自各阶段的令牌份额。

paragraphs.en: Method mechanism. One author coded method mechanisms for all 160 enhanced–baseline pairs, examining method outputs, subsequent agent actions, and validation feedback, and using the paired baseline to contextualize differences in outcome and cost. The codebook defines five codes, each with explicit inclusion and exclusion rules. Access or use limitation covers cases in which the agent could not access the method, did not use its output, or had no opportunity to use it. Unsuitable signal requires a specific deficiency in the information or feedback the method supplied. Input construction gap requires a usable signal followed by an unresolved constraint on input format, reachability, or generation. Context recovery requires evidence that information was removed or summarized and later retrieved again, documented by the pre-compression content, the post-compression content, and the subsequent retrieval; repeated reading alone is insufficient. Overhead reversal is determined from billing records rather than trace inspection: it applies when main-model cost is below the baseline but total cost, including auxiliary calls, exceeds it. Multiple codes may apply to a pair, and pairs without supporting evidence receive no code. Counts include successful pairs, and each pair is counted at most once per code.
paragraphs.zh: 方法机制。 一位作者为全部 160 对增强-基线模型编码了方法机制，考察了方法输出、后续智能体行动和验证反馈，并利用配对的基线模型来解释结果和成本差异的背景。 该编码手册定义了五个编码，每个编码都有明确包含和排除规则。 访问或使用限制涵盖智能体无法访问该方法、未使用其输出，或没有机会使用其输出的情况。 信号不适用要求方法提供的信息或反馈存在特定缺陷。 输入构建缺口要求存在可用信号，但随后输入格式、可达性或生成方面存在未解决的约束。 上下文恢复需要证据表明信息曾被移除或摘要化，并随后被重新获取；该证据需由压缩前内容、压缩后内容以及后续检索过程共同记录，仅重复阅读并不足够。 额外开销逆转通过账单记录而非追踪检查来确定：当主模型成本低于基线，但包含辅助调用的总成本超过基线时适用此情况。 一对模型可能同时适用多个编码，而没有支持证据的模型对则不分配任何编码。 统计数量包括成功匹配的模型对，且每对模型在每个编码下最多只被计数一次。

paragraphs.en: Evidence traceability. Each annotation links its supporting evidence to a source and locator. Case records also retain competing explanations, such as exploratory failure, interruptions, and divergent execution paths.

paragraphs.en: Efficiency methods show inconsistent benefits. PAgent reduces Codex’s total cost from $21.43 to $17.00 while increasing success from 80% to 100%, but increases EnIGMA’s cost from $21.06 to $23.22 while success falls from 50% to 30%. All four methods increase OpenCode’s total cost without improving its success rate. Thus, no evaluated method reduces cost while preserving success across all four agents. paragraphs.en: Code localization and understanding ( L ) accounts for 43.1% of total tokens, followed by vulnerability reasoning and trigger design ( H ) at 17.3%; together, they account for 60.4%. Their relative shares vary across agents. L accounts for 60.3% in EnIGMA and 39.7% in OpenCode, while H is Cybench’s largest stage at 29.5%. The combined share ranges from 44% in Codex to 71% in EnIGMA. Both stages can involve source inspection: L concerns general program structure, whereas H tests specific vulnerability hypotheses. These shares measure billed usage during each activity, including historical context, and do not directly measure redundant reading or new reasoning.

Second, L consumption continues after the first feedback in other traces, showing that code inspection remains part of the refinement process. paragraphs.en: Lower cost with retained success occurs in 24.4% of pairs. Figure 3 (a) compares the 160 enhanced runs with their matched baselines. In 39 pairs (24.4%), both runs succeed and the enhanced run costs less. Of the 91 pairs in which both runs succeed, only these 39 reduce cost. Enhancements also coincide with 14 gains, where only the enhanced run succeeds, and 21 losses, where only the baseline succeeds. paragraphs.en: The limitations differ by method. paragraphs.en: The existing methods address history length, hypothesis selection, execution feedback, and code navigation, but their benefits depend on whether the output resolves the agent’s current uncertainty at an acceptable cost. paragraphs.en: Our empirical study ( § 3 ) suggests that efficient vulnerability discovery requires both reducing the cost of source inspection and helping agents connect code to trigger conditions. RQ2 identifies code understanding and vulnerability reasoning as the main sources of token consumption and failure, while RQ3 shows that existing methods can leave essential trigger conditions unresolved or add substantial overhead. Motivated by these findings, AVRI returns relevant code together with supported relations between input values and unsafe-operation conditions, within a bounded response. It also retains this evidence for reuse in subsequent analysis and input construction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实证研究（§ 3）表明，高效的漏洞发现既需要降低源代码检查的成本，也需要帮助智能体将代码与触发条件关联起来。 RQ2 指出，代码理解和漏洞推理是令牌消耗和失败的主要来源，而 RQ3 则显示，现有方法可能会留下未解决的必要触发条件，或带来巨大的额外开销。 基于这些发现，AVRI 在有限的响应范围内，返回相关代码以及输入值与不安全操作条件之间的支持关系。 它还会保留这些证据，以便在后续分析和输入构建中重复使用。

paragraphs.en: We use three terms throughout this section. Source code is the program text that the agent inspects. Input handling is the code that reads external input and passes its values into the program. An unsafe-operation condition states when a selected operation violates a program constraint, such as an array bound. AVRI connects input handling to these conditions through source locations and analysis rules. The resulting connections are static analysis results; the agent still uses execution to check whether a candidate input produces an observable failure.

paragraphs.en: With ordinary search and file-reading tools, the agent reads the copy and then its caller. It must distinguish the source-length check from the destination bound, map n n to the second input byte, and include the mode check in its trigger condition. These tools can provide enough information to solve the example, but the agent must assemble and retain the relation across their outputs. Reading only the copy misses the call guards; reading only the harness can make its length check appear sufficient.

paragraphs.en: With AVRI , the agent requests the copy and its caller, then analyzes the memcpy operation. paragraphs.en: BET also supports a concrete follow-up. After context compaction, the agent may return to input construction and choose a nine-byte payload. Recovering the saved guard n ≤ size − 2 n\leq\texttt{size}-2 lets it determine that the input must contain at least eleven bytes: the hexadecimal header 01 09 followed by nine payload bytes. A shorter input would be rejected before the copy. This illustrates how saved evidence can support a later decision without rereading the caller. paragraphs.zh: BET 还支持具体的后续操作。 在上下文压缩之后，智能体可以返回输入构建阶段，并选择一个九字节的负载数据。 恢复保存的守卫 n ≤ size − 2 n\leq\texttt{size}-2，使其能够确定输入必须至少包含十一个字节：十六进制头 01 09，后跟九个字节的负载数据。 较短的输入在复制之前就会被拒绝。 这说明了保存的证据如何能够在不重新读取调用者的情况下支持后续决策。 这并非对令牌节省量的衡量，也不是观察到的崩溃；执行过程仍然必须测试候选方案。 不支持的关系仍保持明确未解决的状态。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows how the interface supports these interactions. A shared backend provides source queries and analysis queries. A Bidirectional Evidence Trace (BET) stores how input values reach program operations, the conditions under which those operations are unsafe, and the supported connections between them. The backend can reuse this evidence without inserting the entire BET into the agent’s context. The agent chooses what to inspect and test; AVRI supplies code, analysis results, and explicitly unresolved questions.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了该界面如何支持这些交互。 共享的后端提供源查询和分析查询。 双向证据追溯（BET）记录了输入值如何到达程序操作、这些操作不安全时的条件，以及它们之间的支持连接。 后端可以复用这些证据，而无需将整个 BET 插入到智能体的上下文中。 智能体选择要检查和测试的内容；AVRI 提供代码、分析结果以及明确未解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Return related code together. A source query selects code by file, symbol, or source location. For a function, AVRI can return its body, referenced declarations, and a limited number of relevant helper functions. For a source location, it starts with the enclosing code region. In the running example, the destination declaration gives the eight-byte bound, while the caller supplies the payload pointer, length, and guards. Returning these fragments together reduces the need to issue a separate read merely to interpret the first response. Exact line-range reads remain available.

File discovery and text search provide starting points when the target is unknown; small search results can include nearby code.

paragraphs.en: Expose calls and conditions. Source queries also return callers, uses, declarations, call arguments, and conditions involving a parameter. A condition summary retains Boolean grouping and branch direction: size < 2 on a returning branch implies that the following call requires size ≥ 2 \texttt{size}\geq 2 only if the control flow supports that interpretation.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes how AVRI connects forward input relations with backward unsafe-operation conditions through supported substitutions while retaining guards and unresolved dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 总结了 AVRI 如何通过支持的替换将前向输入关系与后向不安全操作条件连接起来，同时保留守卫和未解析的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Follow input values from the harness. Forward analysis starts with input handling. AVRI models supported byte reads, explicit decoding, cursor movement, and a limited set of input-provider methods. It records the resulting expressions, call arguments, source locations, and assumptions. In Figure 6 , it records that the second unsigned byte supplies the copy length, the first byte selects the branch, and the payload begins at data + 2 . Input-provider methods require a matching implementation or fingerprint; an unsupported version does not inherit an assumed byte-consumption order.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循测试框架提供的输入值。 正向分析从输入处理开始。 AVRI 模型支持字节读取、显式解码、光标移动以及有限数量的输入提供者方法。 它会记录生成的表达式、调用参数、源位置以及假设条件。 在图 6 中，它记录了第二个无符号字节提供复制长度，第一个字节选择分支，而有效载荷从 data + 2 开始。 输入提供者方法需要匹配的实现或指纹；不支持的版本不会继承假设的字节消耗顺序。

paragraphs.en: Input can affect a value, choose a branch, or establish program state through earlier operations. AVRI keeps these cases distinct. An input-controlled branch may enable an operation without allowing the agent to assign an arbitrary value to the affected state. Similarly, a partial call index provides candidate connections from the harness; it cannot prove that an unlisted function is unreachable.

paragraphs.en: Work backward from the selected operation. The agent selects an operation to inspect. Backward analysis starts with a modeled unsafe-operation condition and follows supported definitions, assignments, comparisons, and direct calls. In the running example, writing n n bytes to the eight-byte destination is out of bounds when n > 8 n>8 . Substituting the caller’s length gives data[1] > 8 \texttt{data[1]}>8 . The call guards additionally require mode data[0] = 1 \texttt{data[0]}=1 and sufficient source bytes, n ≤ size − 2 n\leq\texttt{size}-2 , after the two-byte header check.
paragraphs.zh: 从选定的操作开始反向推导。 智能体选择一个操作进行检查。 反向分析从一个建模的非法操作条件开始，并遵循受支持的定义、赋值、比较和直接调用。 在运行示例中，当 n > 8 时，向八字节的目的地写入 n 字节是越界的。 代入调用者的长度后，得到 data[1] > 8。 此外，在检查两字节的头部之后，调用守卫还要求 mode data[0] = 1 且源字节足够，即 n ≤ size − 2。

paragraphs.en: The analysis follows local control flow and a limited number of calling contexts. It stops at unresolved aliases, unsupported side effects, indirect calls, or ambiguous macro behavior. It distinguishes a relation that remains unknown, work not completed within the analysis budget, and evidence omitted only from the displayed response. These require different next steps: inspect more code, resume analysis, or retrieve a saved result. AVRI is not a whole-program verifier or symbolic executor. The agent uses its existing tools to explore unsupported cases and test inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析遵循局部控制流和有限数量的调用上下文。 它在未解析的别名、不支持的副作用、间接调用或宏行为的歧义处停止。 它能区分仍然未知的关系、在分析预算内未完成的工作，以及仅从显示结果中省略的证据。 这些情况需要不同的后续步骤：检查更多代码、继续分析，或获取已保存的结果。 AVRI 并非一个全程序验证器或符号执行器。 智能体使用其现有工具来探索不支持的情况和测试输入。

paragraphs.en: A BET groups evidence for one source snapshot, harness, and analysis configuration. It stores forward results, backward results, their supported connections, assumptions, and unresolved questions. Each result refers to supporting source locations; derived conditions also record the rules used to obtain them. In the running example, the saved evidence includes the mode and length reads, their relation to the call guards, the destination bound, and the combined condition. Recovering the source-length guard later supports the eleven-byte candidate in Figure 6 without repeating the same analysis.
paragraphs.zh: A BET 为一组源快照、利用配置和分析配置收集证据。 它存储正向结果、反向结果、这些结果所支持的联系、假设以及未解决的问题。 每个结果都引用了支持它的源位置；派生条件还会记录用于获得这些结果的规则。 在当前的示例中，保存的证据包括模式读取和长度读取、它们与调用守卫的关系、目标绑定以及组合条件。 之后恢复源长度守卫，可以在不重复相同分析的情况下支持图 6 中的十一字节候选项。

paragraphs.en: Agent hypotheses and execution observations can be saved alongside analysis results, but are labeled separately. A hypothesis is not a static derivation, and a static derivation is not an observed crash. When the agent corrects a record or withdraws a hypothesis, BET retains its history and marks dependent records for review. A failed test alone does not prove that the unsafe-operation condition is impossible.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的假设和执行观察结果可以与分析结果一同保存，但会单独标记。 假设并非静态推导，而静态推导也并非观察到的崩溃。 当智能体更正记录或撤回假设时，BET 会保留其历史记录，并标记相关依赖记录以供审查。 仅凭一次测试失败，无法证明不安全操作的条件不可能发生。

paragraphs.en: Save results without extra bookkeeping. Source queries save evidence and query metadata. Analysis queries can create or reuse a BET internally when the target and analysis configuration are known. The agent receives the requested result without having to maintain BET identifiers or revision numbers after each query. Explicit commands remain available for recording notes, corrections, and recovery requests.

paragraphs.en: Invalidate results when their basis changes. Versioned JSON records are stored outside the read-only source and runtime directories. Locks, revision checks, and atomic file replacement protect updates. Repeating an unchanged analysis need not create a new revision. Cached results depend on source identity, analysis configuration, backend version, and query parameters; displayed BET views also depend on the record revision and display settings. Editing a working note does not invalidate an unrelated source query. Changing the source or another analysis dependency invalidates the affected result while preserving its history.
paragraphs.zh: 当结果的基础发生变化时，应使其失效。 带版本标识的 JSON 记录存储在只读源目录和运行时目录之外。 锁、修订检查和原子文件替换可保护更新操作。 重复执行未更改的分析无需创建新的修订版本。 缓存结果取决于源身份、分析配置、后端版本和查询参数；所显示的 BET 视图也取决于记录修订版本和显示设置。 编辑工作笔记不会使不相关的源查询失效。 更改源或其他分析依赖项会使受影响的结果失效，但会保留其历史记录。

paragraphs.en: Saving a result and showing it again to the model are separate choices. Internal reuse can avoid backend work without adding tokens to the agent’s context. Recovering evidence after context compression may avoid repeated reading, but routinely inserting summaries can add reading and writing costs.
paragraphs.zh: 保存结果和再次将其展示给模型是两个独立的选择。 内部复用可以在不向智能体的上下文中添加标记词的情况下，避免后端工作。 在上下文压缩后恢复证据或许可以避免重复阅读，但常规地插入摘要则可能增加读写成本。

paragraphs.en: Keep responses within an output budget. AVRI prioritizes the requested code and the relations needed to interpret it. Large results are returned in excerpts with omitted ranges or continuation information. Conditions remain grouped so that shortening a response does not silently remove an alternative. Overlapping source fragments appear once within a response. An incomplete response states what is missing.
paragraphs.zh: 将回复控制在输出预算范围内。 AVRI 优先处理所请求的代码以及解释该代码所需的关系。 大型结果将以片段形式返回，其中会省略部分范围或提供续接信息。 条件保持分组状态，因此缩短回复不会悄无声息地移除某个替代方案。 重叠的源片段在回复中仅出现一次。 不完整的回复会说明缺失的部分。

sents.zh: 大型结果将以片段形式返回，其中会省略部分范围或提供续接信息。

sents.en: Conditions remain grouped so that shortening a response does not silently remove an alternative.
sents.zh: 条件保持分组状态，因此缩短回复不会悄无声息地移除某个替代方案。

sents.en: Overlapping source fragments appear once within a response.
sents.zh: 重叠的源片段在回复中仅出现一次。

sents.en: An incomplete response states what is missing.
sents.zh: 不完整的回复会说明缺失的部分。

paragraphs.en: A repeated request still returns usable code or evidence. The agent may have lost an earlier response during context compression or may need to check it again. Reusing a cached computation therefore does not mean replacing the answer with an identifier that the agent must reconstruct.
paragraphs.zh: 重复请求仍然会返回可用的代码或证据。 智能体可能在上下文压缩过程中丢失了之前的响应，或者需要再次检查该响应。 因此，重用缓存的计算结果并不意味着用某个标识符替换答案，而该标识符需要智能体自行重建。

paragraphs.en: Recover evidence when needed. The context-recovery profile makes saved evidence available at context compaction, when the retained conversation is being shortened. It does not append a BET index to every request. A report profile returns query results without adding saved working state, while a full profile also presents continuing state. Shared instructions remain separate from changing work records so that the stable prompt prefix can be reused. These profiles allow the cost of context recovery to be evaluated separately from the usefulness of source and analysis queries.
paragraphs.zh: 在需要时恢复证据。 上下文恢复配置文件可在上下文压缩时提供已保存的证据，此时保留的对话正在被缩短。 它不会为每个请求附加 BET 索引。 报告配置文件返回查询结果时不会添加已保存的工作状态，而完整配置文件还会呈现持续状态。 共享指令与变化的工作记录保持分离，以便可以重复使用稳定的提示前缀。 这些配置文件允许将上下文恢复的成本与源查询和分析查询的有用性分开评估。

sents.en: Recover evidence when needed.
sents.zh: 在需要时恢复证据。

sents.zh: 上下文恢复配置文件可在上下文压缩时提供已保存的证据，此时保留的对话正在被缩短。

sents.zh: 共享指令与变化的工作记录保持分离，以便可以重复使用稳定的提示前缀。

sents.en: These profiles allow the cost of context recovery to be evaluated separately from the usefulness of source and analysis queries.
sents.zh: 这些配置文件允许将上下文恢复的成本与源查询和分析查询的有用性分开评估。

paragraphs.en: Use the agent’s existing execution tools. AVRI is designed as a general interface for agents, with a shared backend that can be exposed through native tool interfaces or command-line services. Agent-specific adapters connect these services to the host agent’s tool invocation and context-management mechanisms. The adapters provide only task-visible materials and place writable evidence records in the run directory. Builds, candidate-input execution, and inspection of files outside the indexed source remain available through the agent’s existing tools.
paragraphs.zh: 使用智能体现有的执行工具。 AVRI 被设计为智能体的通用接口，具有共享的后端，该后端可以通过原生工具接口或命令行服务暴露出来。 特定于智能体的适配器将这些服务连接到主机智能体的工具调用和上下文管理机制。 这些适配器仅提供任务可见的材料，并将可写入的证据记录放置在运行目录中。 构建、候选输入执行以及对索引源之外文件的检查仍可通过智能体现有的工具使用。

paragraphs.en: The adapters separately log tool outputs and the content supplied to the model, including timing, cache status, and usage. These records distinguish backend reuse, evidence recovery, and billed tokens. Fewer queries or shorter responses do not by themselves establish savings: the agent may still spend more effort reasoning or testing. We therefore evaluate the cost of complete runs and outcomes of vulnerability discovery, using interaction records to explain the results.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器会分别记录工具的输出内容以及提供给模型的内容，包括时间戳、缓存状态和用量信息。 这些记录能够区分后端重用、证据恢复和计费令牌。 查询次数减少或响应变短本身并不能说明节省了成本：智能体可能仍然在推理或测试上投入了更多精力。 因此，我们基于交互记录来解释结果，从而评估完整运行过程以及漏洞发现成果的成本。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether AVRI reduces the cost and time of complete runs while preserving outcomes of vulnerability discovery ( RQ4 ). We compare AVRI with the baseline and four existing efficiency methods on a separate set of CyberGym tasks, assessing success and recall alongside cost and elapsed time. This joint assessment examines whether efficiency gains are accompanied by a loss in effectiveness at discovering vulnerabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估 AVRI 在保持漏洞发现结果（RQ4）的同时，是否降低了完整运行的成本和时间。 我们在一个独立的 CyberGym 任务集上，将 AVRI 与基线方法以及四种现有的效率提升方法进行比较，评估其成功率和召回率，同时考察成本和耗时。 这项联合评估旨在检验效率的提升是否伴随着漏洞发现有效性的下降。

sents.zh: 我们评估 AVRI 在保持漏洞发现结果（RQ4）的同时，是否降低了完整运行的成本和时间。

paragraphs.en: We focus the evaluation on Codex and OpenCode because the earlier empirical study found substantially lower success rates for Cybench and EnIGMA, together with generally higher costs ( Table 1 ). The evaluation cohort consists of 20 CyberGym tasks that were randomly selected and are disjoint from the 10 tasks used in the earlier empirical study. The same 20 tasks are used for Codex and OpenCode under Baseline (the agent itself), AgentDiet, Revelio, PAgent, and CodeGraph. Codex uses GPT-5.5; OpenCode uses DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) , as DeepSeek’s most advanced model and is officially claimed to outperform DeepSeek-V4-Pro at lower cost.

paragraphs.en: All selected runs use the harness setting and the 7,200-second per-run time limit. Success and recall follow the execution-based definitions in § 2 . We derive them from vulnerable- and fixed-build submission records, not from agent self-reports or successful verification HTTP requests. Time and cost include all 20 selected runs, including failures. Revelio’s separate preprocessing time and model usage are included; CodeGraph’s recorded initialization time is retained; AgentDiet’s auxiliary calls are charged without adding their elapsed time twice.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 shows that AVRI reduces complete-run cost and time for both agents while preserving baseline success rates. For Codex, AVRI lowers total cost from $132.65 to $108.75 (18.0%) and time from 50,968 to 33,313 seconds (34.6%). Success remains at 85%, while recall increases from 65% to 75%. For OpenCode, AVRI lowers cost from $4.38 to $3.34 (23.7%) and time from 25,324 to 24,017 seconds (5.2%), maintaining 100% success and 90% recall.
paragraphs.zh: 表3显示，AVRI在保持基准成功率的同时，降低了两种智能体的完整运行成本和时间。 对于Codex，AVRI将总成本从132.65美元降至108.75美元（下降18.0%），时间从50,968秒降至33,313秒（下降34.6%）。 成功率仍保持在85%，而召回率则从65%提升至75%。 对于OpenCode，AVRI将成本从4.38美元降至3.34美元（下降23.7%），时间从25,324秒降至24,017秒（下降5.2%），同时保持了100%的成功率和90%的召回率。

paragraphs.en: Among the evaluated configurations, AVRI achieves the lowest total cost and time for each agent. All four existing methods increase OpenCode’s cost, and AgentDiet also loses one success. For Codex, Revelio slightly reduces cost but loses one success; the other methods increase cost without improving success or recall. Thus, AVRI is the only evaluated method that reduces cost for both agents without lowering either effectiveness metric. These findings describe aggregate outcomes on the 20 evaluation tasks, with one run per agent–configuration–task combination.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估的配置中，AVRI 为每个智能体实现了最低的总成本和时间。 所有四种现有方法都增加了 OpenCode 的成本，而 AgentDiet 也损失了一次成功。 对于 Codex，Revelio 略微降低了成本，但损失了一次成功；其他方法则增加了成本，却未能提升成功率或召回率。 因此，AVRI 是唯一一种在评估中能够同时降低两个智能体的成本，且未降低任何有效性指标的方法。 这些发现描述了在 20 项评估任务上的汇总结果，每个智能体–配置–任务组合仅运行一次。

paragraphs.en: Failure bottlenecks and method mechanisms were each coded by one author without independent review. We did not assess inter-coder agreement or consistency through repeat coding for these two axes. The codebook, source-linked evidence, and revision records support traceability, but do not rule out systematic interpretive bias in category assignments and frequencies.
paragraphs.zh: 失败瓶颈和方法机制均由一位作者独立编码，未经过独立审查。 我们未通过重复编码来评估这两个维度的编码者间一致性或稳定性。 编码手册、与原始数据关联的证据以及修订记录支持了可追溯性，但无法排除在类别分配和频率统计中存在的系统性解释偏差。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. Attributing an outcome change to a method is the weakest link in any such comparison, and RQ3 rests on one run per agent, method, and task, which cannot separate a method effect from run variance by replication. We therefore credit a method only when a trace exhibits a visible chain of method event, agent consumption, and state change, and retain competing explanations per case. The evaluation protocol in § 5 likewise uses one run per agent, configuration, and task and holds the model fixed within each agent; it therefore shares this limitation regarding run-to-run variation.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 将结果变化归因于某种方法是此类比较中最薄弱的一环，而研究问题3（RQ3）基于每个智能体、每种方法和每项任务仅运行一次，因此无法通过重复实验区分方法效应与运行变异。 因此，只有当一条轨迹显示出明确的方法事件链——即方法事件、智能体消耗和状态变化——时，我们才会认可该方法的有效性，并且对每个案例保留其他可能的解释。 §5 中的评估协议同样对每个智能体、每种配置和每项任务仅运行一次，并在每个智能体内保持模型固定；因此，它在运行之间的变异方面也存在同样的局限性。

sents.en: Internal validity.
sents.zh: 内部效度。

sents.en: Attributing an outcome change to a method is the weakest link in any such comparison, and RQ3 rests on one run per agent, method, and task, which cannot separate a method effect from run variance by replication.

sents.en: We therefore credit a method only when a trace exhibits a visible chain of method event, agent consumption, and state change, and retain competing explanations per case.
sents.zh: 因此，只有当一条轨迹显示出明确的方法事件链——即方法事件、智能体消耗和状态变化——时，我们才会认可该方法的有效性，并且对每个案例保留其他可能的解释。

sents.en: The evaluation protocol in § 5 likewise uses one run per agent, configuration, and task and holds the model fixed within each agent; it therefore shares this limitation regarding run-to-run variation.

paragraphs.en: External validity. Our findings come from four agents on one benchmark family, in C and C++ projects, with the harness and target already fixed, and generalization beyond that setting is not established. The large combined token share of L and H across four scaffolds with different interaction designs, one of which ran a different model, makes a single-scaffold artifact unlikely. The fixed-harness assumption, however, is load bearing: AVRI ’s backend stays light precisely because the analysis region is bounded, and we would not expect the same design to transfer unchanged to open-ended attack surface discovery. Memory-safety defects in C and C++ also suit constraint atoms such as length and offset better than logic flaws in managed languages would.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 我们的研究结果来自一个基准族中的四个智能体，涉及 C 和 C++ 项目，其中测试框架和目标均已固定，因此无法确定结论能否推广到该设置之外的情况。 在四种具有不同交互设计的架构中，L 和 H 的联合令牌份额均较大，其中一种架构运行的是不同的模型，这使得单一架构造成的偶然性极不可能存在。 然而，固定测试框架的假设至关重要：AVRI 的后端之所以保持轻量，正是由于其分析区域受到限制；我们不会期望相同的设计能够毫无变化地应用于开放式的攻击面发现任务。 C 和 C++ 中的内存安全缺陷也比受管理语言中的逻辑缺陷更适合与长度和偏移量等约束原子相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Conclusion validity. The 20-task evaluation shows lower aggregate cost without lower observed success or recall for the two evaluated agents. However, one run per configuration and task does not establish the robustness of these gains to run-to-run variation, and the absence of component ablations prevents us from isolating the contribution of each mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 结论效度。 20项任务的评估显示，在两个被评估的智能体中，总成本更低，但观察到的成功率和召回率并未随之降低。 然而，每种配置和任务仅运行一次，无法证明这些收益对每次运行之间的差异具有稳健性；此外，由于缺乏组件消融分析，我们无法确定每种机制的具体贡献。

paragraphs.en: Agents for vulnerability discovery. LLM agents support vulnerability discovery through source analysis and interaction with executable environments. RepoAudit ( Guo et al., 2025 ) combines on-demand data-flow analysis, agent memory, and validation of path conditions to audit repositories while limiting false positives. ACTaint ( Lin et al., 2025 ) uses static analysis to guide agents in identifying sensitive sinks and tracing untrusted inputs to detect access-control vulnerabilities in smart contracts. EnIGMA ( Abramovich et al., 2025 ) equips agents with interactive debuggers and server connections to improve vulnerability discovery and exploitation on capture-the-flag challenges. In penetration testing, PentestGPT ( Deng et al., 2024 ) coordinates reasoning, generation, and parsing modules to maintain context across testing steps. These systems demonstrate complementary ways to organize security analysis, but their evaluations concern different tasks, environments, and success criteria. Our study focuses on the cost and failure bottlenecks of agents that search reachable project code and construct a crashing input from a harness entry point. By examining execution traces across agents and efficiency methods, we connect token expenditure to activities and bottlenecks that affect vulnerability discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 用于漏洞发现的智能体。 LLM 智能体通过源代码分析和与可执行环境的交互来支持漏洞发现。 RepoAudit（Guo 等人，2025）结合了按需数据流分析、智能体记忆和路径条件验证，在限制误报的同时对代码库进行审计。 ACTaint（Lin 等人，2025）利用静态分析指导智能体识别敏感数据汇点，并追踪不可信输入，以检测智能合约中的访问控制漏洞。 EnIGMA（Abramovich 等人，2025）为智能体配备了交互式调试器和服务器连接，从而提升在“夺旗”挑战中的漏洞发现和利用能力。 在渗透测试中，PentestGPT（Deng 等人，2024）协调推理、生成和解析模块，以在整个测试过程中保持上下文连贯性。 这些系统展示了组织安全分析的不同互补方式，但它们的评估涉及不同的任务、环境和成功标准。 我们的研究重点关注在搜索可达项目代码并从测试框架入口点构造崩溃输入时，智能体的成本与失败瓶颈问题。 通过考察不同智能体和效率方法在执行轨迹上的表现，我们将令牌消耗与影响漏洞发现的活动和瓶颈联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Agent efficiency methods. Related work improves efficiency through workflow simplification, selective context retrieval, and changes to tool interaction. Agentless ( Xia et al., 2025 ) demonstrates that a fixed pipeline of localization, repair, and validation can resolve software issues at low cost without autonomous action selection. AutoCodeRover ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) narrows repair context through structure-aware code search and, when tests are available, spectrum-based fault localization. LLMCompiler ( Kim et al., 2024 ) plans and executes independent function calls in parallel to reduce latency and interaction costs. At the interface level, SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) designs repository navigation and editing commands around agents’ needs, while ADI ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) replaces fine-grained debugger interaction with function-level traces and high-level navigation. These approaches motivate reducing the work required to obtain useful information, but their benefits do not establish which intervention addresses the dominant costs of vulnerability discovery. Our empirical comparison examines this question through activity-level token use and failure analysis. AVRI then targets repeated source reading and reconstruction by retaining a source-anchored evidence trace that links input propagation to candidate unsafe operations and records unresolved conditions across turns.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体效率方法。 相关研究通过简化工作流程、选择性检索上下文以及调整工具交互来提升效率。 Agentless（Xia 等人，2025）表明，一个固定的定位、修复和验证流程能够以低成本解决软件问题，而无需自主选择行动。 AutoCodeRover（Zhang 等人，2024）通过结构感知的代码搜索以及（在有测试用例时）基于谱的故障定位来缩小修复上下文范围。 LLMCompiler（Kim 等人，2024）并行规划和执行独立的功能调用，以减少延迟和交互成本。 在接口层面，SWE-agent（Yang 等人，2024）围绕智能体的需求设计仓库导航和编辑命令，而 ADI（Xiang 等人，2026）则用函数级追踪和高层导航取代了细粒度的调试器交互。 这些方法启发我们减少获取有用信息所需的工作量，但它们带来的益处并未明确说明哪种干预措施能解决漏洞发现中的主要成本问题。 我们的实证比较通过活动层面的令牌使用量和故障分析来探讨这一问题。 AVRI 随后通过保留一个以源代码为锚点的证据追踪来针对重复的源代码读取和重构操作；该追踪将输入传播与潜在的非法操作关联起来，并记录各轮次中未解决的条件。

paragraphs.en: We studied 200 CyberGym execution traces from four agents and found that code localization and understanding account for the largest token share, while vulnerability reasoning and trigger design form the main bottleneck in failed runs. Existing efficiency methods rarely preserve success at lower cost. We therefore presented AVRI , which keeps a persistent Bidirectional Evidence Trace linking harness input to unsafe-operation conditions, so agents can reuse evidence instead of rebuilding it. On 20 tasks, AVRI reduces total cost by 18.0% for Codex and 23.7% for OpenCode while preserving success rates and improving or maintaining recall.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了来自四个智能体的 200 条 CyberGym 执行轨迹，发现代码定位和理解占据了最大的 token 份额，而漏洞推理和触发器设计则是运行失败的主要瓶颈。 现有的效率提升方法很少能在降低成本的同时保持成功性。 因此，我们提出了 AVRI，它保留了一条持续的双向证据轨迹，将测试输入与不安全操作的条件关联起来，使智能体能够重复利用证据，而无需重新构建。 在 20 项任务中，AVRI 将 Codex 的总成本降低了 18.0%，OpenCode 的总成本降低了 23.7%，同时保持了成功率，并提升了或维持了召回率。
